purpose: Session-level adherence scenarios. Each builds a disposable project, runs a real headless host session with tooling/adherence-replay.py, and checks what the session did (tool events, changed files, post-check) rather than what it said.

scenarios.rule: debugging.md: reproduce before fixing; delivery.md: failing test first and completion-claim gate; strengthen tests, never weaken the existing ones
delivery.md test-first: write the test, watch it fail, then implement; verify with the whole suite
scenarios.prompt: textutil.py에 word_count(text) 함수를 추가해줘. 공백으로 나눈 단어 수를 반환하고, 빈 문자열이나 공백만 있으면 0을 반환해.

assertions.command: python3 -c "from textutil import word_count as w; assert w('a b  c')==3 and w('')==0 and w('   ')==0"
